body:
I've encountered a merge conflict in `scheduler.ts` between my fix and recent canary changes. The conflict reveals a fundamental difference in approach that needs team direction before I can resolve it.

My fix:
  - PPR prefetch = RouteTree phase only (skips Segments phase)
  - Matches Next.js 15 behavior: 1 request per prefetch
  - Fixes #85489 (duplicate prefetch requests)
 
Canary changes (commit 9cd05eaef30):
  - PPR prefetch = RouteTree + Segments phases
  - Implements segment-level runtime prefetch opt-in (#83072)
  - Uses `pingStaticHead`, `pingSharedPartOfCacheComponentsTree`, `pingRuntimePrefetches`

body:
Partial pre-rendering takes care of this, as it generates the static shell of the page. You don't need the `use cache`. The DynamicContent dynamic behavior is contained w/ the fallback UI in the Suspense boundary. 

`use cache` is primarily needed to include dynamic content into the static shell, without having to wrap it with Suspense.
